messages:
anya: Heads up — seeing KV residency drift in prod after long-context sessions. reuse rate for prefix keys drops ~40% over a 30m window. attaching short profile snippet and heap diff link.

mateo: ugh. can you paste the top-line numbers?

anya: sure. peak kv_mem 28GB -> 36GB over 30m on a single host. unique_kv_keys metric jumped 3x. reuse_pct (prefix) fell from 82% -> 49%.

sam: that aligns with alerts: token latency spiked when node memory climbed. I saw fragmentation alarms too.

kevin: possible suspect: key canonicalization change from last week? iirc we added tenant salt normalization in the key pipeline. if canonicalization is non-deterministic across requests, duplicates explode.

jia: i repro'd locally with a stress harness. snippet: 
```
// pseudocode for key generation
key = sha256(tenant_id + "|" + session_prefix + normalize(prompt))
// normalize had a dedupe map that mutated per-request
```
When normalize uses an LRU cache without stable ordering it can return different whitespace-normalized strings (weird).

anya: thanks — that would explain cross-request duplication despite same logical prefix. perf traces show many small KV pages allocated for near-identical keys.

perf-bot: perf-alert: kv_eviction_rate increased 2.4x on host i-0a1b2c (region us-west-2) at 2026-03-18T15:08:00Z.

ops-bot: snapshot saved: s3://redwood-prod-snapshots/kv/1769554321/heapdiff-1769554321.tar.gz

mateo: can we add a temporary metric to count canonical key collisions? maybe emit a tag when normalized_key != stable_normalized_key.

kevin: yeah adding a deterministic canonicalize() and an assertion in canary should be quick. also propose emitting kv_key_fingerprint (short) to ensure we're not storing duplicates with different salts.

jia: will open a PR with two changes: 1) replace mutable dedupe map in normalize with pure deterministic function, 2) emit metric kv_key_fingerprint short-hash on store. test plan attached in PR.

anya: thanks. next steps: canary the change on a single shard, watch unique_kv_keys and reuse_pct. if it holds, roll to full cluster. i'll run a synthetic longctx run to validate memory growth stops.

sam: FYI, please also add an alert for kv_frag_ratio > 0.6; fragmentation seems to be the multiplier.

kevin: agree. added to rollout checklist: "check unique_kv_keys, reuse_pct, kv_frag_ratio, eviction_rate". :thumbsup:

anya: ephemeral note: also saw TTL variance — some keys were created with no TTL due to earlier bug. PR will ensure default TTL applied.

mateo: sounds good. thanks team. we'll track in the perf board and link this thread.

anya: filed follow-up ticket PERF-1129 with repro steps and heap diffs. final: will canary tomorrow 03/19 09:00 PT. :calendar:
